title: Third-party payment gateway timeouts on payment-service
description: payment-gateway-external returned elevated timeouts and 5xx; payment-service retries and circuit-breaker state transitions tracked the outage. Provider recovered; deferred charges settled.

2026-08-06T10:35:19.700Z ERROR [payment-gateway-external] HTTP 503 Service Unavailable: upstream processor capacity exceeded
2026-08-06T10:38:55.800Z ERROR [payment-service] circuit breaker CB-payment-gateway OPEN after 8 consecutive timeouts
2026-08-06T10:41:12.300Z WARN  [payment-service] deferring 1240 charge authorizations to retry queue while breaker OPEN
